slides.title: Laptops are 90% of the devices
slides.body:
And about 10% of the work.
Supplicant, domain, certificate, done.

slides.title: Then you meet the rest
slides.body:
Printers. HVAC. Cameras.
The lab instrument whose vendor says *static IP*.

slides.title: Exceptions aren't cleanup
slides.body: They're the majority of the work — and all of the *political risk*.

slides.title: Decide the fallback first
slides.body:
Restrictive MAB is a decision.
An open VLAN is an *accident*.

slides.title: One owner per class
slides.body:
“Printers” has an owner.
“This printer” has a *ticket*.

slides.title: Expire every exception
slides.body: Or *temporary* MAB quietly becomes the permanent architecture.

slides.title: Where projects actually die
slides.body: Nobody willing to say: then it goes in the *restricted segment*.

slides.title: The laptops are the demo.
slides.body:
The exceptions are the project.
Design the exception process before the policy.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
